definitions.explanation: Microscopic single-celled organisms. Used in both scientific contexts and everyday language when talking about hygiene, illness, and food safety.

examples.japanese: {細菌|さいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{繁殖|はんしょく}→繁殖：08671_hanshoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: If you don't wash your hands, germs will get on them.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{細菌|さいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{判明|はんめい}→判明：11785_hanmei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was determined that bacteria were the cause of this food poisoning.

notes:
USAGE:
A technical term used in both scientific and everyday contexts. Unlike the homophone ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧ (recently), this word is written with different kanji and belongs to a completely different semantic field.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細菌|さいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{繁殖|はんしょく}→繁殖：08671_hanshoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: bacteria multiply
- {細菌|さいきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感染|かんせん}する→感染する：26931_kansensuru⟧: to be infected with bacteria
- {細菌|さいきん}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: bacterial testing
- {細菌|さいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{殺|ころ}す→殺す：01944_korosu⟧: to kill germs

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧ (virus) refers to a different type of pathogen. {細菌|さいきん} are living organisms that can be treated with antibiotics, whereas ⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧ cannot.
